title: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin calls Aaron Rodgers drama a 'dumpster fire'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin calls Aaron Rodgers drama a 'dumpster fire'
sources.description: Mike Tomlin, the Steelers' coach for 19 seasons, addressed Aaron Rodgers' Steelers exit at halftime of the Kansas City Chiefs-Buffalo Bills game on NBC.
